MAJOR = a careful player or art lead would reject it.

summary: All 64 pass. In every probe (rise 1-4, w2/w3, both alts) the cuts match the face height exactly and meet the lip and the road. Ramps follow the accepted grass construction (tapered strata cheeks, chevron tread), and their mean colour is within about 10 of the road. Stairs read as steps at 1x. Minors: stair treads differ in colour from the road (sand brown, snow white); cheeks are thin, so stairs look partly like a flat striped panel; cave/sand top steps have comb-like vertical joints; snow/sand lit ramp cheeks are smooth rather than textured; peat stairs have no lip fringe.
